objective: Make Poem Map projection returns deterministic across full reload without introducing a shared session store.
object: Poem Map source identity + view + selected token address

mechanism.restore: On Poem Map boot, accept focus only when source_key exactly matches the current localTextKey(source), the token ID matches /^L\d+T\d+$/, and that token exists in the parsed source.

invariants: The poem source remains local Poem Map authority.
Recipient marks, claims, timing and projections never enter the return witness.
Malformed/stale token addresses or mismatched source fingerprints fail closed.
Existing durable Poem Map RETURN JSON remains unchanged.
No new global/session store is introduced.

proof.lived_phone: pending one complete recipient round trip with full Poem Map reload
